summary_1line: Guha recounts Lakshmana’s refusal of comfort and his grief-filled vigil while Rama and Sita sleep on the forest floor during exile.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama and Sita sleep on a bed of grass by the river while Lakshmana stands guard through the night with bow in hand.
Guha offers Lakshmana a soft forest couch under the trees, but Lakshmana refuses while watching over the sleeping Rama.
Lakshmana gazes sorrowfully at Rama lying on the bare earth, lamenting the fate of Ayodhya and their grieving parents.
